title.en: Evidence through change: candidates propagated through every admitted change
title.zh: 经变化的证据：经每个被允许之变化传播的候选

statement.en: Every lawful history of readings, admitted changes and responses keeps the actual world among the possible ones once it is there, so a certificate over their pooled models stays sound; predicting a change can reopen excluded alternatives, and an understated change can leave false confidence.
statement.zh: 由读数、被允许之变化与回应构成的每段合律历史，都使已在可能世界之中的实际世界留在其中，故其汇集模型上的证书保持可靠；预测一次变化可重开已排除的备择，被低报的变化可留下虚假的信心。

laws.en: A reading keeps every world that fits it, so the actual world, fitting its own report, is kept; prediction of an admitted change keeps every lawful successor of a possible world. Along every lawful history, from a state whose possible worlds hold the actual one and lie among the represented worlds, the finish has the same.
laws.zh: 读数保留与之相合的每个世界，故与其自身报告相合的实际世界被保留；对被允许变化的预测保留每个可能世界的每个合律后继。从可能世界含实际世界且皆在被表示世界之中的状态出发，沿每段合律历史，终态亦然。

laws.en: A certificate over the pool of the possible worlds' models then warrants, for the causes acting on commands, whatever every faithful domain outside those causes warrants, at every lawful finish.
laws.zh: 于是在每个合律终态，可能世界之模型汇集上的证书，对作用于命令的原因，担保这些原因之外每个忠实域所担保者。

laws.en: Witnesses: after a scan leaves two models, predicting a reset reopens all three and the certificate that passed fails; a control change after the last report reopens all three; a change recorded as steady when the world moved leaves the actual world outside the possible ones, the certificate passing on compromised support while the audit fails.
laws.zh: 见证：扫描留下两个模型后，预测一次重置重开全部三个，原先通过的证书失效；最后一次报告之后的控制改变重开全部三个；世界已移动却记为不变，使实际世界落在可能世界之外，证书凭受损的支持通过，而审计失败。

laws.en: Over the reals, an intervention certified from a reading with symmetric error E keeps the end within the target [L, B] wherever the actual value lies within E of the reading, and needs 2E ≤ B − L; with error growing as σ + ρt it needs 2ρt ≤ B − L − 2σ.
laws.zh: 实数上，由对称误差为 E 的读数所证的干预，在实际值与读数相差不超过 E 处使终值落在目标 [L, B] 之内，并需 2E ≤ B − L；误差按 σ + ρt 增长时需 2ρt ≤ B − L − 2σ。

hypotheses.en: The worlds, the admitted changes and their successors, the reporting law and the faithfulness of diagnostics are supplied; recording, local atomic steps and command execution are protected.
hypotheses.zh: 世界、被允许之变化及其后继、报告律与诊断之忠实为给定；记录、局部原子步与命令执行受保护。

hypotheses.en: For the bound, the error model σ + ρt and an additive intervention bounded by what is left are supplied, over the real numbers (Mathlib).
hypotheses.zh: 就界而言，误差模型 σ + ρt 与以剩余为界的相加干预为给定，在实数上（Mathlib）。

hypotheses.en: Axioms: in TemporalInspection received_actual_retained and the understated-change witness use propext, the prediction and history laws propext and Quot.sound, the reset and control witnesses none; the ChangingDependency declarations use propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice, as their receipts report.
hypotheses.zh: 公理：TemporalInspection 中 received_actual_retained 与低报变化之见证用 propext，预测与历史诸律用 propext 与 Quot.sound，重置与控制见证无公理；ChangingDependency 的声明用 propext、Quot.sound 与 Classical.choice，如其回执所报。

does_not_show.en: That the admitted changes are the actual ones: the transition relation is supplied, not inferred from a notice or a clock.
does_not_show.zh: 被允许的变化就是实际的变化：迁移关系为给定，而非由通告或时钟推出。

does_not_show.en: Physical recovery or legitimacy: a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant.
does_not_show.zh: 物理恢复或正当性：通过的证书只担保忠实域所担保者。

does_not_show.en: That a certificate which passes is sound when a change is understated: the actual world can fall outside the possible ones.
does_not_show.zh: 变化被低报时，通过的证书仍可靠：实际世界可落在可能世界之外。

detail.en: A movement recorded as steady: the actual world leaves the possible ones, the certificate passes on supports the actual faults include, and the audit fails (understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence).
detail.zh: 移动被记为不变：实际世界离开可能世界，证书凭实际故障所含的支持通过，审计失败（understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence）。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked: TemporalInspection by its own checker (Lean 4.29.1, receipt 20261008T114957.579255Z); ChangingDependency by its package checker (Lean 4.30.0-rc2 with Mathlib); axioms as named; current bytes bound. Read against the Lean for this record; not independently reviewed.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 实查：TemporalInspection 经其自身检查器（Lean 4.29.1，回执 20261008T114957.579255Z）；ChangingDependency 经其包检查器（Lean 4.30.0-rc2 与 Mathlib）；公理如所列；当前字节皆绑定。为本记录对照 Lean 审读；未经独立审查。

next_delta.en: Join the inspection to the core's pooled envelopes: state the propagated candidates as a process on situations whose admitted changes are steps, so that the history law is an instance of the core's kept candidates.
next_delta.zh: 把此检查接入核心的汇集包络：把传播的候选陈述为情境上的过程，被允许的变化为其步，使历史之律成为核心所保留候选的一个实例。

correspondence.en: Propagating a set of possible states through admitted transitions and filtering by later readings is set-membership state estimation (Schweppe 1968; Bertsekas and Rhodes 1971).
correspondence.zh: 经被允许的迁移传播可能状态之集，再以后来的读数过滤，即集员状态估计（Schweppe 1968；Bertsekas 与 Rhodes 1971）。

detail.en: Soundness of a certificate over pooled models at one time; here kept along a history of admitted change.
detail.zh: 某一时刻汇集模型上证书的可靠；此处沿被允许之变化的历史保持。

detail.en: An explanation of a dated record gives the content where every rival is told apart by a dated control.
detail.zh: 对带日期记录的解释给出内容，在每个对手都被带日期的对照分开之处。

detail.en: Telling answers apart with fallible witnesses at one time.
detail.zh: 在某一时刻以可错的见证者分辨回答。

history.en: 27 October 2026: added (DF2), that candidates propagated through admitted change keep the actual world and a pooled certificate sound, the witnesses of unpredicted and understated change, and the tolerance a growing error needs; from DEFECTS-FOUND (triage row 133); study section 426.
history.zh: 2026年10月27日：新增（DF2），经被允许之变化传播的候选保留实际世界并使汇集证书可靠，未预测与被低报之变化的见证，以及增长之误差所需的容差；出自 DEFECTS-FOUND（分诊第 133 行）；研究第 426 节。
